assumptions.note: 40/day is a busy averaged matchday across the 5 major European leagues; real load is lumpy (weekend-heavy).

sustainability.note: Live budgets observed on an authenticated /football/matches response; the ~16.8k/month estimate is well within the 100k cap.

recommendation: Sustainable on plans with >= ~17k monthly requests. On a trial (10% metered) reduce odds snapshots to 4/fixture and poll lineups only in the LATE/FINAL windows; the quota guard pauses conservatively when Remaining is low or headers are absent.
